FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Pinnacle Accounting Solutions, we provide a comprehensive range of accounting and financial services primarily tailored for individual taxpayers and small businesses with straightforward financial needs. Our operations include individual tax preparation services, basic bookkeeping, payroll processing, and financial reporting, all designed to ensure compliance with current tax regulations. We utilize secure, industry-standard accounting software to manage our clients' data, maintain strict confidentiality, and adhere to robust data security protocols. Our team consists of certified public accountants (CPAs) and trained bookkeepers, all of whom are up-to-date with their credentials to ensure accurate and high-quality service. We connect with our clients through transparent, written engagement agreements that outline the scope of our services and associated fees, fostering trust and clarity. Regular internal audits of our accounting practices ensure compliance with legal standards and ongoing improvements in our service delivery. We take pride in our commitment to ethical practices and do not engage with clients involved in high-risk financial activities or those with histories of regulatory violations, allowing us to maintain a solid reputation within the industry.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses occurred on January 5, 2023, due to a failed accounting software system upgrade, resulting in temporary inaccessibility to clients' financial records. The estimated amount lost in productivity was approximately $1,500. The system has since been upgraded and is now operational.
